Ooredoo met en avant son expertise techn: Ooredoo highlights its technological expertise at the ICT Africa Summit 2026
Alger, le 23 avril 2026 – Fidèle à sa ré: Algiers, April 23, 2026 – True to its reputation as an innovation leader, Ooredoo Algeria stood out during the second day of the ICT Africa Summit 2026. This key event, bringing together major decision-makers of the African tech ecosystem, was the setting for rich exchanges on the latest advancements in digital transformation.
Le point d’orgue de cette journée a été: The highlight of the day was the visit of the Minister of Post and Telecommunications, Mr. Sid Ali Zerrouki, to the Ooredoo booth. This official stop highlighted the cutting-edge solutions developed by the operator, bearing witness to the institutional recognition of its driving role in Algeria's digital development.
À cette occasion, Ooredoo a dévoilé son: On this occasion, Ooredoo unveiled its new Cloud Computing service, built around the Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) model. Designed to meet businesses' needs for flexibility, this solution offers highly secure, on-demand computing resources without requiring initial investment. A strategic lever enabling Algerian companies to increase their operational agility while controlling their costs.
Parallèlement, Ooredoo a animé une confé: Simultaneously, Ooredoo hosted a high-level strategic conference on the theme "B2B Use Cases with 5G". Led by the expertise of two of the company's senior executives, Mr. Karim Melab, Director of Network Engineering, and Mr. Ali Djallal Fatnassi, Deputy Director of B2B Services, this session illustrated the profound changes in the entrepreneurial ecosystem in the 5G era.
La présentation a décrypté les cas d’usa: The presentation decoded concrete use cases of 5G private networks across various strategic sectors. Emphasis was placed on the combined potential of 5G and the Internet of Things (IoT) to optimize industrial processes, strengthen operational efficiency, and accelerate corporate digitalization.
Par cette participation remarquée, Oored: Through this notable participation, Ooredoo Algeria confirms its status as a benchmark technology partner. The operator continues its commitment to supporting the national economic fabric through innovative, secure solutions that create high added value.
